annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/480 of 1 April 2020 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/480 of 1 April 2020 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 102/6
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds references conferring presumption of conformity, including EN ISO 18497 on safety of highly automated agricultural machines, and schedules withdrawal of superseded standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds 27 harmonised standard references to Annex I of Decision 2019/436, conferring presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC.
Includes EN ISO 18497:2018 on safety of highly automated agricultural machines.
Adds superseded standards to Annex III with withdrawal dates, mostly 2 October 2021.
Enters into force on publication; point (1) of Annex I applies from 2 October 2021.
